en.text: Division of Labour

zh.text: 分工

en.text: Specialization is beneficial to an economy because

zh.text: 專業化對經濟有好處是因為

en.text: more resources are used in producing capital goods.

zh.text: 可有更多資源使用在生產資本物品上。

en.text: the threat of protectionism can be avoided.

zh.text: 可免受保護主義的威脅。

en.text: the risk of unemployment is lowered.

zh.text: 失業的可能性較低。

en.text: the productivity of the factors of production is raised.

zh.text: 生產因素的生產力獲得提高。

en.text: HKCEE 1993 Paper 2 Q15

zh.text: 香港中學會考 1993 卷二 第 15 題

en.text: Which of the following is
NOT
an advantage of division of labour?

zh.text: 下列哪一項
不是
分工的好處？

en.text: higher work incentive

zh.text: 有更大工作熱誠

en.text: higher labor productivity

zh.text: 勞動生產力更高

en.text: a smaller amount of tools required

zh.text: 需要較少量的工具

en.text: the right person doing the right job

zh.text: 合適的人員做合適的工作

en.text: HKCEE 1994 Paper 2 Q59

zh.text: 香港中學會考 1994 卷二 第 59 題

en.text: Which of the following is
NOT
an advantage of division of labour?

zh.text: 下列哪一項
並非
分工的好處？

en.text: greater economies of scale

zh.text: 可享有更多規模經濟

en.text: economy in the use of capital

zh.text: 經濟地使用工具

en.text: higher labour productivity

zh.text: 提高勞工生產力

en.text: improved skill through more practice

zh.text: 透過更多練習使技巧得以改進

en.text: HKCEE 1999 Paper 2 Q52

zh.text: 香港中學會考 1999 卷二 第 52 題

en.text: When division of labour is practised,

zh.text: 若實施分工，

en.text: workers have greater job satisfaction.

zh.text: 工人會有更大的工作滿足感。

en.text: machines are used more intensively.

zh.text: 機器的使用率會更高。

en.text: producers produce a greater variety of goods to suit different consumer tastes.

zh.text: 生產商會生產更多種類的貨品以適合顧客的不同口味。

en.text: the occupational mobility of workers increases.

zh.text: 工人的職業流動性會增加。

en.text: HKCEE 2000 Paper 2 Q19

zh.text: 香港中學會考 2000 卷二 第 19 題

en.text: Which of the following is an advantage of division of labour?

zh.text: 下列哪一項是分工的好處？

en.text: A wider choice of goods and services can be provided.

zh.text: 有更多種類的物品和服務以供選擇。

en.text: Workers have a greater incentive to work.

zh.text: 工人更有工作熱誠。

en.text: Workers have higher occupational mobility.

zh.text: 工人的職業流動性較高。

en.text: Less time is required to train workers.

zh.text: 訓練工人需時較少。

en.text: HKCEE 2001 Paper 2 Q16

zh.text: 香港中學會考 2001 卷二 第 16 題

en.text: In a secondary school, different teachers are responsible for teaching different subjects. Which of the following are reasons for the above arrangement?

zh.text: 在一所中學裏，不同的教員負責任教不同的科目。下列哪項是上述安排的原因？

en.text: (1) and (2) only
(1) and (3) only
(2) and (3) only
It can reduce the cost of training.

zh.text: 減低訓練成本。

en.text: Practice makes perfect.

zh.text: 熟能生巧。

en.text: Different teachers are good at teaching different subjects.

zh.text: 不同教員擅長任教不同的科目。

en.text: HKCEE 2003 Paper 2 Q17

zh.text: 香港中學會考 2003 卷二 第 17 題

en.text: When division of labour is practised,

zh.text: 若實施分工，

en.text: firms will enjoy greater economies of scale.

zh.text: 廠商會享有更多規模經濟。

en.text: workers will have a higher occupational mobility.

zh.text: 工人的職業流動性會更高。

en.text: workers will have a higher income.

zh.text: 工人會有更多收入。

en.text: output per man-hour will increase.

zh.text: 每工時產出會上升。

en.text: HKCEE 2004 Paper 2 Q17

zh.text: 香港中學會考 2004 卷二 第 17 題

en.text: Division of labour can raise labour productivity. One reason is that

zh.text: 分工可提高勞工生產力，其中一個原因是

en.text: fewer tools are needed.

zh.text: 使用較少工具。

en.text: geographical mobility is increased.

zh.text: 增加地域流動性。

en.text: time is saved from not moving from task to task.

zh.text: 節省時間，因爲工人毋須轉換工序。

en.text: there would be a higher degree of interdependence among different production stages.

zh.text: 不同工序之間的依賴性較高。

en.text: HKCEE 2007 Paper 2 Q14

zh.text: 香港中學會考 2007 卷二 第 14 題

en.text: Which of the following is a possible reason for the increase in average labour productivity resulting from practising division of labour?

zh.text: 下列哪項是因實施分工而導致平均勞工生產力上升的一個可能的原因？

en.text: Fewer capital goods are required.

zh.text: 所需資本物品較少。

en.text: The occupational mobility of workers is higher.

zh.text: 工人的職業流動性較高。

en.text: The total wage income of workers is higher.

zh.text: 工人的總工資收入較高。

en.text: Time is saved from moving workers between different tasks.

zh.text: 節省了工人在不同工序之間轉換工作所需的時間。

en.text: HKCEE 2009 Paper 2 Q17

zh.text: 香港中學會考 2009 卷二 第 17 題

en.text: A large supermarket chain store is composed of different sections: marketing, sales, delivery, accounts and management. An advantage of the above arrangement is:

zh.text: 一家大型超市連鎖店設有下列部門：市場推廣、銷售、送貨、會計及管理。上述安排有以下的優點：

en.text: The staff will have a higher working incentive.

zh.text: 員工會有更大的工作誘因。

en.text: A greater variety of services can be provided to customers.

zh.text: 可以向顧客提供更多種類的服務。

en.text: The supermarket chain store can enjoy economies of scale.

zh.text: 該超市連鎖店可享有規模經濟。

en.text: The supermarket chain store can save on the cost of training its staff.

zh.text: 該超市連鎖店可節省訓練員工的成本。

en.text: HKCEE 2010 Paper 2 Q16

zh.text: 香港中學會考 2010 卷二 第 16 題

en.text: Which of the following is an advantage of division of labour?

zh.text: 下列哪項是分工的好處？

en.text: Capital goods can be more fully utilized.

zh.text: 資本物品可以更物盡其用。

en.text: The risk of unemployment is lowered.

zh.text: 失業的風險下降。

en.text: Different stages of production become more independent.

zh.text: 不同的生產階段變得更獨立。

en.text: A wider choice of goods and services can be provided.

zh.text: 可以提供更多物品和服務的選擇。

en.text: HKCEE 2011 Paper 2 Q15

zh.text: 香港中學會考 2011 卷二 第 15 題

en.text: A professor has decided to change the way of marking the exam papers of his subject. Instead of asking his teaching assistants to mark the whole paper for their own classes, he assigns each teaching assistant to mark one question of the paper for the entire candidature. Which of the following situations would likely occur?

zh.text: 一位教授決定改變所任教科目的試卷評改方法：他不再要求其助教們批改他們所屬班別的整份試卷，而是指派每位助教批改全體考生整份試卷的其中一題。下列哪些情況可能會出現？

en.text: (1) and (2) only
(1) and (3) only
(2) and (3) only
The marking will be more accurate since practice makes perfect.

zh.text: 評改會更準確，因為熟能生巧。

en.text: Training time will be reduced as each assistant only needs to know part of the marking schemes.

zh.text: 訓練的時間會減少，因為每位助教只需要了解評卷參考的一部分。

en.text: The tools required for marking will be reduced such as fewer red pens are needed.

zh.text: 評改所需的工具會減少，例如需用較少的紅色原子筆。

en.text: HKDSE 2018 Paper 1 Q11

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 2018 卷一 第 11 題

en.text: In the Outline Development Plan for the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, Hong Kong is an international financial and transportation centre; Macao is a leisure and tourism centre; Guangzhou is an international commercial centre.

zh.text: 在粵港澳大灣區發展規劃綱要中，香港是國際金融和運輸中心，澳門是旅遊休閒中心，廣州是國際商貿中心。

en.text: This is an example of __________ division of labour because _______________.
simple ... each city has its own comparative advantage

zh.text: 簡單 ... 每個城市各有自己的比較優勢

en.text: simple ... each city engages in different production stages

zh.text: 簡單 ... 每個城市都涉及不同生產階段

en.text: regional ... multiple cities cooperate to build the Greater Bay Area

zh.text: 區域 ... 多個城市攜手合作共建大灣區

en.text: regional ... each city has its own specialty of production

zh.text: 區域 ... 每個城市各有自己專長的生產

en.text: HKDSE 2022 Paper 1 Q9

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 2022 卷一 第 9 題

en.text: Which of the following statements about division of labour are correct?

zh.text: 下列哪些關於分工的陳述是正確的？

en.text: (1) and (2) only
(1) and (3) only
(2) and (3) only
When a barter economy starts using money to facilitate exchange, division of labour tends to be practised to a greater extent.

zh.text: 當一個以物易物經濟開始使用貨幣促進交易時，實施分工的程度傾向變得更大。

en.text: When a closed economy opens up to free trade, division of labour tends to be practised to a greater extent.

zh.text: 當一個封閉經濟開放自由貿易時，實施分工的程度傾向變得更大。

en.text: When a small clinic expands into a large hospital, division of labour tends to be practised to a greater extent.

zh.text: 當一間小型診所擴張成一間大型醫院時，實施分工的程度傾向變得更大。

en.text: HKDSE 2025 Paper 1 Q9

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 2025 卷一 第 9 題
